tr.td: Primary care visit for breathlessness, orthopnea, and leg swelling
Two-week heart failure medication safety check and echocardiogram
Three-month heart failure and blood pressure review
Six-month heart failure review with repeat echocardiogram
Start guideline-directed therapy for HFrEF: sacubitril/valsartan, carvedilol, and empagliflozin, with furosemide for congestion; add spironolactone after the two-week potassium check
Check a basic metabolic panel one to two weeks after each renin-angiotensin or mineralocorticoid antagonist change, then every three to six months when stable
Treat to a blood pressure below 130/80 with home blood pressure and daily weight logs; low-sodium diet
Give intravenous ferric carboxymaltose for iron deficiency with ferritin below 100 ng/mL and transferrin saturation below 20%
Tobacco cessation counseling with nicotine replacement and a quit date
Cardiology referral to confirm the diagnosis, review the echocardiogram, and guide titration
Repeat echocardiogram three to six months after reaching tolerated doses to decide on device therapy
Lower blood pressure below 130/80 by the six-month review
Improve the KCCQ-12 overall summary score by at least 20 points by the three-month review
Stop smoking by the three-month review
No cigarettes since April; nicotine patch course completed
Reach the highest tolerated doses of guideline-directed therapy by the six-month review
Sacubitril/valsartan 49/51 mg twice daily, carvedilol 12.5 mg twice daily, spironolactone, and empagliflozin
